segments.caption: Three children run down a grassy hill covered in autumn leaves and joyfully dive into a large pile, laughing as they bury themselves in the foliage.
Three children are joyfully playing in a large pile of autumn leaves in a grassy field, laughing and tumbling through the leaves before scrambling out and running off.
Three children are joyfully playing in a large, leaf-strewn field during autumn, energetically running and kicking up piles of fallen leaves in a carefree game.
Three children playfully run and jump through a large pile of fallen autumn leaves in a grassy yard, their energetic movements kicking up the leaves as they chase each other near a parked truck.

In a sun-dappled suburban yard blanketed with fallen leaves, three children are joyfully playing in a large pile. They run, tumble, and toss leaves into the air, their energetic movements creating a dynamic scene of autumnal play. A red pickup truck and a black car are parked under a covered carport in the background, while a woman and a dog are visible near the house, observing the children's lively antics.

A young boy in a dark outfit runs toward them, then crouches down to playfully dig or scoop up leaves from a pile, before standing up and continuing to play. A young boy in a dark blue shirt runs across the frame, while a girl in a blue striped shirt and another in pink pants play near a pile of leaves. The scene is set beside a driveway with a parked truck, capturing a moment of carefree, active play on a crisp fall day.
